'''Esaga''' was an astronomical object<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> located in the [[Esaga system/Legends|Esaga system]], a part of the [[Esaga sector/Legends|Esaga sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> After its restoration around [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]], the [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] moved aggressively beyond the Republic's frontier to defend its [[Colonist/Legends|colonies]] and commerce. Although few records survived from that [[Time/Legends|time]], [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] later [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Music/Legends|songs]] continued to mention deeds of bravery committed by members of the Republic Navy during conflicts at Esaga, [[Caulbon]], and [[The Sundered Veil/Legends|the Sundered Veil]]. During the [[Pius Dea Era]], a period of time lasting from approximately [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] to [[11,000 BBY]], Esaga was situated outside of the Republic's borders.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Esaga was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Esaga [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square R-11.<ref name="EAOC" />
